restoration_note: The teaching describes the five registers at which the Lord is recognized as he goes forth: Father of Greatness → Beloved of Lights → Third Ambassador → Jesus the Radiance → Mind of Light → Form of Light. Most gaps are clipped letters at line breaks (titles, perfect prefixes, genitive markers, splits like ⲡϣⲁⲣⲡ / ⲡⲙⲁⲍⲥⲛⲉⲩ / ⲙⲟⲛⲟⲅⲉⲛⲏⲥ), strongly constrained by parallel formulae and the Manichaean lexicon. Four mid-line lacunae remain too weakly constrained: {27} (3-char span between 'air' and 'wheel'), {39} (~4 chars after 'Son'), {40} (~7-char speech opener before 'I am'), and the feminine-noun titles in §430-431 ({31}, {32}), where I offer cautious low-confidence proposals along the spiritual axis the reading sets out (Mother of Light; unity).

coptic_restorations.basis: Editor's restoration; refrain 'one came forth again from another' (ⲛⲧⲁ ⲟⲩⲉ ⲁⲛ ⲉⲓ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ⲛ̄ⲟⲩⲉ); standard adverb of repetition.
Completes ⲡⲉⲧⲉ — relative pronoun introducing ⲙⲛ̄ ϣⲓ 'has no measure'.
Completes ⲁⲧⲉϩⲙ̄ⲛ̄|ⲧⲛⲁⲟ split across line break; abstract ⲙⲛⲧⲛⲁⲟ 'greatness'.
ⲙⲟⲛⲟⲅⲉⲛⲏⲥ 'Only-Begotten' — standard Greek loan, traces ⲙ_ⲛⲟⲅⲉⲛⲏⲥ require ⲟ.
ⲡϣ_ + line break to ⲣ̄ⲡ → ⲡϣⲁⲣⲡ 'first'.
Established formula ϯⲟⲩ ⲛⲓⲱⲧ 'the five Fathers' (lexicon: Five Great Greatnesses); cohort of the teaching's title.
Verbal ending of ⲧⲱⲍⲙⲉ 'emanate/call forth' — perfect ⲁϩ-ⲧⲱⲍⲙⲉ.
ⲡϣⲁⲣⲡ 'the first' split: ⲡ_ⲣⲡ requires ϣⲁ.
ⲡⲧⲛⲁⲟ 'the Great' — completes the standard masc. epithet preceding ⲡ̄ⲛⲁ̄ on the next line ('Great Spirit').
ⲡⲙⲁⲍⲥⲛⲉⲩ ⲡⲉ 'the second is' — ordinal formula matching ⲡϣⲁⲣⲡ above.
ⲡⲙⲉⲣⲓⲧ ⲛ̄ⲛⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ 'Beloved of the Lights' — established lexicon title; ⲛⲟⲩⲁⲓ̈ⲛⲉ visible on next line.
Standard epithet ⲉⲧⲟ ⲛ̄ⲉⲁⲩ 'who is glorious' followed by copula+article ⲡⲉⲧ-, exactly mirroring §417 of Jesus the Radiance.
ⲡⲉⲧⲧⲁⲓ̈ⲁⲓ̈ⲧ ⲡⲉ 'the honored one' — qualitative of ⲧⲁⲓⲟ (lexicon ⲡⲣ̄ⲣⲟ ⲙⲡⲧⲁⲓⲟ).
Perfect ⲁϩ- + ⲟⲩⲱⲗⲡ̄ 'has been revealed' (lexicon: ⲟⲩⲱⲗⲡ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'manifest').
ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ⲛ̄ϩⲏⲧϥ̄ 'from him'; trace ⲏⲧϩ shows the pronoun-bearing prep, completing ⲁⲃⲁ_ ⲛ̄_ⲏⲧϥ.
Established Manichaean title ⲡⲙⲁⲍϣⲁⲙⲧ ⲙⲡⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲧⲏⲥ 'Third Ambassador' (lexicon).
ⲛ̄ⲛⲥⲩⲙⲃⲟⲩⲗⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ 'of all the counselors' — standard plural Greek loan + ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ collective.
Editor's restoration; the same descent-formula 'who came forth from (the Father)' appears at §392, §411, §422.
Article ⲡ + ⲉⲧⲉϣⲁⲩϯ creates 'the (one) through whom they give'; standard relative.
ⲧⲥⲟⲫⲓⲁ — Greek loan, single-letter break.
ⲛⲁⲣⲭⲱⲛ 'the Archons' — visible ⲛⲛ̄_ⲱⲛ requires ⲁⲣⲭ (lexicon).
ⲡⲱⲕ ⲛϩⲏⲧ 'pride-of-heart'; single vowel.
ⲡⲛⲟⲩⲥ ⲛ̄ⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ 'Mind of Light' — established title (lexicon: Light Mind).
ⲧⲁϩ-ⲙⲉⲥ 'called' split across line break; verb ⲧⲱϩⲙⲉ.
ⲡⲛⲁⲟ ⲛ̄ⲕⲣⲓⲧⲏⲥ 'the great Judge' — standard Manichaean title for the second power of Jesus the Radiance.
Genitive marker before ⲛ̄ⲣⲱⲙⲉ 'of men' — judges all souls of men.
Circumstantial ⲉⲣⲉ + possessive ⲧⲉϥⲥⲕⲏⲛⲏ 'while his tabernacle (is established)'.
3-char span between 'air' and the article ⲡ + ⲧⲣⲟⲭⲟⲥ on the next line; possibilities (ⲧⲡⲉ 'heaven', ⲡⲣⲏ 'sun') are not securely constrained. Honest non-restoration.
Editor's note: article ⲡ before ⲧⲣⲟⲭⲟⲥ.
Genitive of stars: ⲡⲧⲣⲟⲭⲟⲥ ⲛ̄ⲛ̄ⲥⲓⲟⲩ 'wheel of the stars' (lexicon).
ⲡⲗⲓⲗⲟⲩ 'the Youth' — Jesus the Youth (Lilou), standard third power title (lexicon).
Feminine 'great X of light': trying ⲧⲛⲁⲟ ⲙ̄ⲙⲉⲩ ⲛ̄ⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ 'great Mother of Light' (paired with the Youth Lilou). Roughly fits 6-char estimate. Genuinely uncertain — the editor's ⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ is too long.
'two faces in unity gazing toward heaven' — ⲡⲟⲩⲱⲧ 'oneness/unity' fits 6-char span and the doctrinal point that the calling and the hearing are one face. Tentative.
ϩⲙ̄ 'in' — single letter completing the preposition.
Conjunction 'and' joining ⲡⲧⲱϩⲙⲉ 'the calling' and ⲡⲥⲱⲧⲙⲉ 'the hearing' — the Great Counsel pair (lexicon: ⲡⲧⲱⲍⲙⲉ ⲙⲛ̄ ⲡⲥⲱⲧⲙⲉ).
ⲧⲱⲕ ⲁⲣⲉⲧ⸗ 'stand firm' — ⲁϥⲧⲱⲕ ϩⲱϥ ⲁⲣⲉⲧϥ 'he likewise stood firm before his Father'.
ⲡϥⲓ̈ⲱⲧ 'his Father' — possessive at line end.
Article ⲡⲣ̄ⲣⲟ 'the King' — title formula.

5-char title for the Lord at this register; ⲡⲣ̄ⲣⲟ ⲙⲡⲧⲁⲓⲟ 'King of Honor' (lexicon entry; the Lord governing the seven firmaments) fits length and matches the heaven-establishing context of this passage.
~4 chars after ⲡⲥⲏⲣⲉ 'the Son' — possibilities (ⲛ̄ⲧⲡⲉ 'of heaven', ⲙ̄ⲡⲉⲁⲩ 'of glory') are not securely constrained. Honest non-restoration.
7-char speech-opener preceding ⲁⲛⲁⲕ 'I am'. ⲭⲉ alone is too short and there is no firm parallel for the longer span. Honest non-restoration.
ⲁⲛⲁⲕ 'I' — independent pronoun opening the saying.
Editor's bridge formula 'this is what I am saying to' linking 'with my Father' to ⲱⲧⲛⲉ 'you (pl.)'.
Mirror of §434 ⲁⲣⲁϥ ϩⲁⲧⲙ̄ ⲡⲁⲓ̈ⲱⲧ 'him with my Father' → here 'him with your Father' (cf. Jn 8:38 form).
ⲃⲱⲕ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'go forth' — partial ⲃ visible; standard verb of leaving the body.
ⲡϣⲁⲙⲧ 'three' — confirmed by §445-446 'these are the three angels'.
ⲉϩⲉⲙⲁⲍⲧⲉ 'to hold/grasp' — paralleled by ⲡⲉⲧⲉⲙⲁⲍⲧⲉ in §444.
ⲁⲩⲟⲱⲗⲡ̄ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'they were disclosed' — revelatory doublet with ⲟⲩⲱⲛⲍ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ (lexicon).
ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲩ '(of) them, their' — required for 'before their faces'.
Standard pairing 'the righteous and the faithful' (δίκαιοι καὶ πιστοί) for the Manichaean elect.

english_restorations.basis: ⲁⲛ 'again' — refrain of repeated emanation.
Standard title 'Third Ambassador' (lexicon).

english_restorations.proposed_english: who came forth from the First Father
english_restorations.basis: Standard descent-formula paralleling §392, §411, §422.
Article + relative ⲡⲉⲧⲉϣⲁⲩϯ — 'he is the one through whom they give'.
ⲛⲁⲣⲭⲱⲛ 'Archons' — particular forms of the self (lexicon).
ⲡⲛⲁⲟ ⲛ̄ⲕⲣⲓⲧⲏⲥ 'great Judge' — discriminating power (lexicon: great judges / King's judges).
3-char Coptic span between 'air' and 'the wheel' is not securely restorable.
ⲡⲗⲓⲗⲟⲩ — Jesus the Youth (Lilou), the third power of Jesus the Radiance (lexicon).
Tentative reading of feminine 'great Mother of light' as the consort/correlate of the Youth at this register; not securely constrained.
Two faces (calling and hearing) gazing toward heaven 'in unity' — the Great Counsel as one structural conversation. Tentative.
Conjunction joining 'the calling' and 'the hearing'.
ⲧⲱⲕ ⲁⲣⲉⲧ⸗ idiom 'stand firm' — the Youth standing before his Father.
ⲡⲣ̄ⲣⲟ ⲙⲡⲧⲁⲓⲟ 'King of Honor' — the Lord governing the discrete degrees (lexicon).
~4-char epithet after 'the Son' is not securely constrained.
7-char speech opener preceding 'I am' has no firm parallel.

ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲩ 'them/their' — possessive in 'before their faces'.
